reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-random: "Thanks Dana, noted: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 27 January. I'll go by your corrected date, not the earlier one."

I didn't take any other action, since she said none was needed. Her message, including the correction, is saved in the workspace's knowledge brain like every channel message. A renewal date is an account detail, not a money figure, so it's fine to have in a channel.
